warrior.title: Warrior
warrior.description: Melee combat: armour, weapons and endurance.

knight.title: Knight
knight.description: An armoured wall. Knights soak up hits with damage and projectile resistance, armour toughness and stun armour, and hit back with greatswords. Shield and Oakskin let them shrug off fights other classes would run from. Key abilities: Shield, Oakskin.
knight.extra_description: Opens the Knight tab. You can pick 2 archetypes in total.

samurai.title: Samurai
samurai.description: A disciplined duellist who lives on timing. Every katana strike hits harder and cuts through armour, every perfect parry refills stamina and reflects damage, and heavy impacts stagger enemies. No spells, just the blade and a Stance that channels fire, wind, water or earth. Key abilities: Stance.
samurai.extra_description: Opens the Samurai tab. You can pick 2 archetypes in total.

berzerker.title: Berzerker
berzerker.description: Pure aggression. Berzerkers stack raw attack damage, axe damage and life steal, hit more targets per swing and knock them flying. Fang Strike tears the ground open, and Heartstop lets them ignore death for a few seconds. Key abilities: Fang Strike, Heartstop.
berzerker.extra_description: Opens the Berzerker tab. You can pick 2 archetypes in total.

mage.title: Mage
mage.description: Spellcasting: mana, casting speed and arcane study.

holy.title: Holy
holy.description: A healer and support caster. Holy power strengthens light spells, healing received rises, and holy resistance protects against dark magic. Guiding Bolt, Heal, Blessing of Life, Healing Circle and Sunbeam keep a party alive. Key abilities: Guiding Bolt, Heal, Blessing Of Life, Healing Circle, Sunbeam.
holy.extra_description: Opens the Holy tab. You can pick 2 archetypes in total.

flame.title: Flame
flame.description: Burst damage and constant pressure. Fire power and cooldown reduction keep the flames coming, from Firebolt and Fire Breath to Magma Bomb, Heat Surge and Fireball, while ember skin resists fire in return. Key abilities: Firebolt, Fire Breath, Magma Bomb, Heat Surge, Fireball.
flame.extra_description: Opens the Flame tab. You can pick 2 archetypes in total.

lightning.title: Lightning
lightning.description: A mobile storm caster. Lightning power grows, casting barely slows you down, and grounding resists shocks. Electrocute, Ball Lightning, Chain Lightning, Lightning Lance and Lightning Bolt punish anything in reach. Key abilities: Electrocute, Ball Lightning, Chain Lightning, Lightning Lance, Lightning Bolt.
lightning.extra_description: Opens the Lightning tab. You can pick 2 archetypes in total.

necromancy.title: Necromancy
necromancy.description: Blood magic and the risen dead. Blood power and summon damage feed Wither Skull, Blood Slash, Ray of Siphoning, Devour and Raise Dead, turning every fight into a war of attrition. Key abilities: Wither Skull, Blood Slash, Ray Of Siphoning, Raise Dead, Devour.
necromancy.extra_description: Opens the Necromancy tab. You can pick 2 archetypes in total.

ice.title: Ice
ice.description: Control and protection. Ice power, magic resistance and cold resistance back up Icicle, Cone of Cold, Frost Step, Ice Spikes and Blizzard, which slow, freeze and shatter anything that comes close. Key abilities: Icicle, Cone Of Cold, Frost Step, Ice Spikes, Blizzard.
ice.extra_description: Opens the Ice tab. You can pick 2 archetypes in total.

assassin.title: Assassin
assassin.description: Strike first, strike from behind. Daggers, backstab damage, armour negation and protection shred make every opening lethal. Echoing Strikes, Blood Step and Invisibility get you in and out unseen. Key abilities: Echoing Strikes, Blood Step, Invisibility.
assassin.extra_description: Opens the Assassin tab. You can pick 2 archetypes in total.

phantom.title: Phantom
phantom.description: A rapier duellist built around the dodge. Rapiers (a sword with an empty off hand) grow sharper, dodges cost less stamina, and the first hit after a dodge lands as a riposte. Evasion turns incoming blows into blinks. Key abilities: Evasion.
phantom.extra_description: Opens the Phantom tab. You can pick 2 archetypes in total.

scout.title: Scout
scout.description: Speed, range and awareness. Scouts swim faster, break through terrain, resist ender magic and empower ender spells. Teleport, Haste and Planar Sight let them reach, flee and see what others cannot. Key abilities: Teleport, Haste, Planar Sight.
scout.extra_description: Opens the Scout tab. You can pick 2 archetypes in total.

thief.title: Thief
thief.description: Luck and loot. Thieves gain luck, double drops, extra Fortune, longer reach and cheaper anvil repairs. Boogie Woogie claps swap places with creatures or blocks to confuse fights. Key abilities: Boogie Woogie, Block Clap.
thief.extra_description: Opens the Thief tab. You can pick 2 archetypes in total.

ranger.title: Ranger
ranger.description: The wilds: speed, agility, endurance and stranger arts.

wanderer.title: Wanderer
wanderer.description: Built for long journeys. Food lasts longer, mounts run faster, pets and horses hit harder and survive longer, and you step up full blocks. Summon Horse and Counterspell keep the road open. Key abilities: Summon Horse, Counterspell.
wanderer.extra_description: Opens the Wanderer tab. You can pick 2 archetypes in total.

stalker.title: Stalker
stalker.description: Bows and crossbows. Ranged damage, arrow and bolt speed and evocation power make every shot count. Arrow Volley rains arrows on a whole area and Poison Arrow leaves a lingering toxic cloud. Key abilities: Arrow Volley, Poison Arrow.
stalker.extra_description: Opens the Stalker tab. You can pick 2 archetypes in total.

druid.title: Druid
druid.description: Nature magic and the land's healing. Nature power and resistance strengthen Acid Orb, Root, Firefly Swarm and Earthquake, and standing on natural ground slowly heals you. Key abilities: Acid Orb, Root, Firefly Swarm, Earthquake.
druid.extra_description: Opens the Druid tab. You can pick 2 archetypes in total.

cursed.title: Cursed
cursed.description: Cursed techniques fuelled by mana instead of cursed energy, with no cooldowns. Dismantle and Cleave cut enemies apart, and the Malevolent Shrine domain shreds everything around you. Cursed Control makes techniques cheaper; melee resistance and toughness shred round it out. Key abilities: Dismantle, Cleave, Malevolent Shrine.
cursed.extra_description: Opens the Cursed tab. You can pick 2 archetypes in total.
